title: Geschwindigkeitskontrollen im Rahmen der ROADPOL-Aktionswoche „Speedweek“ – Polizei Berlin zieht Bilanz

extraction.summaryEn: Berlin police reported results of the ROADPOL "Speedweek" speed enforcement campaign from 13 to 19 April 2026, including a Blitzermarathon control day on 15 April. At 203 control sites, 6,732 speeding violations were recorded, 58 of them exceeding the limit by more than 31 km/h.
